summary: Bright Mountain Media, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the sale of its domain name www.mom.com and related social media handles to Static Media, Inc. for $1.1 million in cash via its subsidiary CL Media Holdings LLC. Proceeds were used to prepay approximately $613,000 of First Out Loans under the Credit Agreement, fully satisfying the June 2026 amortization payment; the remaining ~$1.0 million in Second Out amortization was paid-in-kind. The deal required and obtained consent from Centre Lane Partners and lenders. This is an asset sale, not a strategic transaction, and does not fall under standard special-situations categories.
